_doc: Thousandvale's PERK FOREST (stream C: js/rules/perk-forest.js builds it, js/rules/perk-rules.js reads its rules; owner guide docs/talents.md). Play-test 1 P6: 'a perk forest with several branches, much more expansive than Farhold' (Farhold js/perks.js: 8 arms, 169 nodes). Fourteen arms (play-test 4 S16 added The Gathering Storm — lightning — and The Old Lore — arcane and nature), every one of them branching into 2-4 paths past ring 6, each path ending in a keystone; ~380 nodes. A stat entry is [derived key, value] and its card line is WRITTEN from the number (perk-forest.js STAT_TEXT), so a card can never disagree with what it does. `rules` are nodes that change a rule: `flag` (read by Farhold's code or by js/rules/perk-rules.js TV_FLAG_READERS), `power` (a Farhold js/effects.js keystone power), `grants` (stats, always on) and `when`/`whenGrants` (stats only in those hands). tests/C/perks.test.mjs fails if any key, flag or power has no reader. Node ids are `<arm>:<ring>:<i>`, `<arm>:path:<branch>:<step>` and `<arm>:key:<rule id>` — a save holds node ids, so moving a node to another arm or ring costs players their point; renaming one costs nothing.

arms.name: The Close Ground
arms.blurb: Reach, weight and the willingness to be hit.

arms.name: The Hunter's Eye
arms.blurb: Pick the moment, and make the moment count.

arms.name: The Long Shot
arms.blurb: Distance, precision and the shot you only get once.

arms.name: The Quick Hand
arms.blurb: Skills that come back sooner, cost less, and chain into each other.

arms.name: The Deep Study
arms.blurb: Power that comes out of a book and goes back into one.

arms.name: The Hexwork
arms.blurb: Burns, poisons, bleeds and curses — the damage that keeps working after you look away.

arms.name: The Kept Company
arms.blurb: What follows you, and what keeps it standing.

arms.name: The Open Hand
arms.blurb: Healing, shielding and standing beside the people you came with.

arms.name: The Held Line
arms.blurb: Armour, a shield, and the patience to be the one who does not move.

arms.name: The Slow Mend
arms.blurb: Nothing on this arm makes a hit hurt less. It gives back what the hit cost you.

arms.name: The Light Step
arms.blurb: The hits that never land, and the fights you choose not to be noticed in.

arms.name: The Long Odds
arms.blurb: What the dead leave behind, and how much of it you notice.

arms.name: The Gathering Storm
arms.blurb: Lightning that will not stay in the sky: shocks, arcs and the crack that follows.

arms.name: The Old Lore
arms.blurb: The slow magics: written arcane letters and the green tongue of roots.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.desc: Block or dodge a hit and your next swing is a guaranteed critical — 100% critical chance on that one swing.

sunder.name: Sunder
sunder.desc: The last swing of every weapon pattern strips 8 armour off the target, permanently — that armour never comes back.

mark.name: Quarry
mark.desc: Your first hit on a target marks it for 8s, and a marked target takes 15% more damage from every source.

cauterise.name: Cauterise
cauterise.desc: A critical hit also sets the target burning: 25% of that hit's damage again, as Burning damage over 4s.

echo.name: Echo
echo.desc: 17% chance (1 cast in 6) that a skill fires a second time and costs no mana.

pack.name: Pack Sense
pack.desc: Your followers heal you for 10% of the damage they deal.

shared_hide.name: Shared Hide
shared_hide.desc: Your followers take 30% of every blow aimed at you, split between them (none of them is ever taken below 1 health by it).

doubled_grasp.name: Doubled Grasp
doubled_grasp.desc: Hold a two-handed weapon in each hand. +18% attack area.

full_swing.name: Full Swing
full_swing.desc: With a two-handed weapon and nothing in the other hand: +30% damage, and every 3rd swing lands as a slam that hits everything within 3.5 metres for 60% of your weapon damage and throws it back.

flurry.name: Flurry
flurry.desc: With a one-handed weapon in each hand: +20% attack speed, and every hit has a 25% chance to land again for 50% of its damage.

shield_wall.name: Shield Wall
shield_wall.desc: With a one-handed weapon and a shield: +15% chance to block, a block stops 30 more damage, and every block answers with a shockwave that hits everything within 3.2 metres for 70% of your weapon damage.

pyre_heart.name: Pyre Heart
pyre_heart.desc: A Burning enemy that dies bursts, hitting everything within 4 metres for 80% of your weapon damage as fire and setting it Burning — a crowd burns down in a chain. Your Burning lasts 3s longer. +6% spell damage.
pyre_heart.cost: −20% damage of every kind but fire.

shatter.name: Shatter
shatter.desc: A Chilled enemy takes 30% more from you, and one that dies Chilled throws 3 shards at the nearest enemies within 7 metres for 70% of your weapon damage each. +6% spell damage.
shatter.cost: −20% damage of every kind but ice.

storm_within.name: Storm Within
storm_within.desc: In a fight, lightning leaves you on its own every 1.5s and strikes the nearest enemy within 10 metres for 50% of your weapon damage, Shocking it. +6% spell damage.
storm_within.cost: −20% damage of every kind but lightning.

plague_bearer.name: Plague Bearer
plague_bearer.desc: A Poisoned enemy that dies passes its poison to every enemy within 5 metres, 25% stronger each time it moves on. +6% spell damage.
plague_bearer.cost: −20% damage of every kind but poison.

hollow_pact.name: Hollow Pact
hollow_pact.desc: A Cursed enemy that dies passes its curse to every enemy within 5 metres, and every hit of shadow damage you land heals you for 8% of it. +6% spell damage.
hollow_pact.cost: −20% damage of every kind but shadow.

halo.name: Halo
halo.desc: Every 2.5s in a fight a ring of light burns every enemy within 5 metres for 50% of your weapon damage as holy and Weakens it, and every hit of holy damage you land heals you for 5% of it. +6% spell damage.
halo.cost: −20% damage of every kind but holy.

overflow.name: Overflow
overflow.desc: Every 3rd skill you cast goes off a second time at 60% of its damage, free. +10% spell damage.

blood_magic.name: Blood Price
blood_magic.desc: Skills are paid for in health instead of mana, and never fail for want of mana. +14% spell damage.
blood_magic.cost: Your mana pool stops mattering, and a skill can leave you on 1 health.

far_shot.name: Far Shot
far_shot.desc: An arrow or a bolt deals more damage the further it has flown: nothing extra at 4 m, up to +50% at 46 m. +5% critical chance.
far_shot.cost: Anything within 4 m of you takes 25% less damage.

the_pack.name: The Pack
the_pack.desc: +2 follower slots, +2 of each thing you summon, and +20% follower damage.

held_ground.name: Held Ground
held_ground.desc: +40% armour, +10% resistance to all damage, and a block stops 25 more damage.

fortunes_tithe.name: Fortune's Tithe
fortunes_tithe.cost: −12% damage — your eye is on the ground rather than on the fight.

slow_blood.name: Slow Blood
slow_blood.desc: 14% life steal, and +5 health a second on top.
slow_blood.cost: −70 maximum health. You live on what comes back, not on what you had.

wind_walk.name: Wind Walk
wind_walk.desc: +15% dodge chance and −25% enemy notice range.
wind_walk.cost: −35% armour — nothing that does land is softened.

finisher.name: Finishing Blow
finisher.desc: Your skills deal 30% more to an enemy under 25% health. +10% critical damage.
finisher.cost: No drawback beyond the points it takes to reach it.

vanguard.name: Fresh Blood
vanguard.desc: While you are above 80% health every hit you land deals 12% more. +30 maximum health.
vanguard.cost: Nothing extra once you are hurt.

stillness.name: Planted Feet
stillness.desc: After 1.5s standing still every hit you land deals 25% more, until you move.

opener.name: First Blood
opener.desc: A hit on an enemy that is still at full health deals 50% more.

weave.name: The Weave
weave.desc: Cast a different skill from your last one within 3s and it costs no mana.

killHaste.name: Momentum
killHaste.desc: Every killing blow you land takes 1s off every one of your cooldowns. +4% attack speed.
killHaste.cost: Nothing on a long fight against one enemy.

mindWard.name: Mind over Body
mindWard.desc: A quarter of every blow you take is paid from your mana instead of your health, while you have mana. +40 maximum mana.
mindWard.cost: Your mana drains when you are hit.

bloodScent.name: Blood Scent
bloodScent.desc: Every hit you land on an enemy suffering a burn, poison, bleed or curse deals 20% more. +10% damage from your burns, poisons, bleeds and curses.
bloodScent.cost: Nothing extra against an enemy that is clean.

contagion.name: Contagion
contagion.desc: When an enemy carrying your burn, poison, bleed or curse dies, each of them jumps to the nearest enemy within 6 metres. +10% damage from them.
contagion.cost: No drawback beyond the points it takes to reach it.

deep_rot.name: Deep Rot
deep_rot.desc: +40% damage from your burns, poisons, bleeds and curses.

earlyBond.name: Early Bond
earlyBond.desc: Your class companion — the creature your class keeps, not a hired blade — normally joins you at level {companionMain}. Take this and it joins you {earlyMainText}. {secondClasses} also have a second one, normally at level {companionExtra}: with this it comes at level {earlyExtra}. +10% damage for all your followers. Classes with a class companion: {companionClasses}.
earlyBond.cost: Hirelings and summoning skills are not changed. A class without a class companion only gets the +10% follower damage.

packTactics.name: Pack Tactics
packTactics.desc: Your followers deal 25% more to whatever you hit last.

brimming.name: Brimming Cup
brimming.desc: Healing that would go past full health goes on to the most hurt member of your party within 30 metres. +10% healing you do.
brimming.cost: No drawback beyond the points it takes to reach it.

rally.name: Banner of the Road
rally.desc: You and every member of your party within 20 metres of you deal 6% more damage. +3% resistance to all damage.

ironPresence.name: Iron Presence
ironPresence.desc: Your damage makes 60% more threat, and your taunts hold 2s longer. +20% armour.

unbroken.name: Unbroken
unbroken.desc: A blow that would kill you leaves you on 1 health instead — once every 90 seconds.

secondWind.name: Second Wind
secondWind.desc: The first time a blow takes you under 35% health you heal 20% of your maximum health — once every 45 seconds. +1 health a second.
secondWind.cost: No drawback beyond the points it takes to reach it.

killBarrier.name: Spoils of the Fallen
killBarrier.desc: Every killing blow you land gives you a barrier worth 8% of your maximum health for 6s. +10 health on every kill.
killBarrier.cost: No drawback beyond the points it takes to reach it.

quietHand.name: Soft Footfall
quietHand.desc: Your damage makes 40% less threat. −10% enemy notice range.
quietHand.cost: Hard to hold an enemy's eye when you need to.

cornered.name: Back to the Wall
cornered.desc: While you are under 35% health every hit you land deals 25% more.

static_charge.name: Static Charge
static_charge.desc: A lightning hit you land has a 25% chance to leave its target Shocked for 3s.

conductor.name: Conductor
conductor.desc: Every hit you land on a Shocked enemy arcs to the nearest other enemy within 6 metres for 35% of your weapon damage as lightning. +10% damage to Shocked enemies.
conductor.cost: −10% damage to enemies that are not Shocked.

thunderhead.name: Thunderhead
thunderhead.desc: A critical lightning hit bursts: everything within 3.5 metres of the target takes 45% of your weapon damage as lightning and is Shocked for 2s. +6% spell damage.

static_coat.name: Static Coat
static_coat.desc: An enemy that hits you is Shocked for 3s and takes 30% of your damage as lightning — once every 2s. +15 magic resistance.

spellwright.name: Spellwright
spellwright.desc: Every arcane hit you land writes a mark on its target for 8s: it takes 4% more damage per mark, up to 5 marks. +6% spell damage.
spellwright.cost: −20% damage of every kind but arcane.

rootbound.name: Rootbound
rootbound.desc: Every nature hit you land slows its target by 25% for 3s and heals you for 4% of the damage. +6% spell damage.
rootbound.cost: −20% damage of every kind but nature.
